This first edition uses a saved research collection. The clock follows New York time; missing minutes use the nearest earlier photograph not yet shown in this session. Once all photographs have been shown, the current one stays. Refreshing clears the history. The collection is checked monthly for new photographs and metadata changes. View photo coverage.
